card.name: Category nouns after quantifiers like all or most
card.fires_on: A general noun such as areas, topics, diseases or categories that follows a quantifier like all, most, every or two. It also fires on linking words in similar spots.

modes.label: Noun after quantifier
modes.description: A plural group noun right after all, most, every or a number, naming a set of items.

modes.description: A small word or bracket after a count or study-type phrase, introducing details.
